Objects of the other kind are passed through.

authored_scope:
Supported:
- Grid sides 10..30, defaulting to 10..22 for random scenes.
- 1..6 frames and 1..6 crosses on request (1..4 each by default).
- Box sizes 3..6 with arbitrary interior cross-bar offsets and colours 1..9 on background 0.
- Partial column overlaps and chains inside lanes up to 9 wide.
- Forceable same-kind stacking, aligned cross-on-cross stacking, and frame/cross pass-through.
- Explicit latent scenes that reproduce the fixtures exactly.

Cross contact:
- Default cross_contact='cell': every cross resting on a cross has bar-to-bar contact, as in all fixtures, so box and cell gravity agree.
- 'box_gap' and 'any' are explicit opt-in extensions, including for explicit scenes.

Requests and validation:
- Dense feasible requests (e.g. 10x10 with 3+3, or 10x11 with 6 frames) are built constructively with lanes.
- Infeasible requests raise ValueError immediately.
- Malformed or nested object arguments raise ValueError.

Not supported:
- Column sharing between objects in different lanes, so random stacking chains never span lanes.
- Frames thicker than one cell, boxes larger than 6, non-black backgrounds, or multi-colour objects.
authored_constraints: Input bounding boxes are pairwise disjoint (no overlap or nesting), so column-sharing same-kind objects have distinct sort rows and processing order is never tied.
Same-colour objects never touch, even diagonally, in input or output; different colours may touch.
Ink covers less than half the grid so background 0 is the majority.
Each lane's object heights sum to at most the grid height, so all stacks fit and output frame and cross boxes never collide.
Output is never identical to the input.
In default 'cell' mode every cross that rests on another cross has a supporting cross whose bar column equals its own bar column.
'box_gap' mode requires at least one non-aligned cross rest and at least 2 crosses.
Crosses have strictly interior bars, frames are at least 3x3 one-cell rings, and both kinds are present in every scene.
